_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround di atas {width}x{height} grid.
Kamu adalah pemain {player_id}. Gerakan sah: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' atau w/s/a/d.
Tujuan: bertahan hidup lebih lama dari yang lain. Jejak-jejak berbahaya; tabrakan dinding mematikan; tabrakan kepala-ke-kepala mematikan keduanya.

game_action.invalid_death: Pamain {player_id} maningga dek ulahnyo indak sah.

outcome.survived_win: Pamain {player_id} salamaik; sadonyo nan lainnyo tajajak.
outcome.all_crashed: Kasadonyo pamain jatuah pado wakatu nan samo.
outcome.outlived: Pamain iko labiah tuo dari nan lain.
outcome.turn_limit: Bateh giliran alah digunoan - nan paliang lamo batahan manang.
